metricsCompared.name: focused security and harness regressions
metricsCompared.baseline: No hostile-workspace passive/autonomous regression or protected-root isolation assertion covered this exploit path.
metricsCompared.candidate: 31 of 31 focused Gemini adapter, runtime-home, auth-readiness, and machine-authority tests passed; the focused native protected-root regression also passed.

rationale: The candidate closes a confirmed high-severity credential disclosure and arbitrary workspace-process execution path at the shared native sandbox and Gemini adapter boundaries. It fails closed before any provider-authenticated Gemini launch, hides executable repository configuration, and applies protected deny configuration in depth. Authenticated Gemini CLI operation is intentionally unavailable until the already-tracked provider-only broker work can prove tool children cannot inherit provider authority; type checking, focused regressions, the live macOS protected-root check, and task validation pass.
